preferences.name: hideDebugUrls
preferences.title: Hide Crash Commands
preferences.label: Hide commands that crash or hang the browser
preferences.description: Hide the Command URLs for Debug — chrome://crash, chrome://hang, chrome://gpucrash and the rest. They deliberately crash, hang, or terminate the browser and will lose unsaved work. Internal debugging pages, which are harmless, are not affected by this.

preferences.name: hideUntrustedUrls
preferences.title: Hide Untrusted Commands
preferences.label: Hide chrome-untrusted:// commands
preferences.description: Hide chrome-untrusted:// commands, which run in isolated security contexts. These are advanced features that may behave unexpectedly if you don't understand their purpose.

preferences.name: hideDeprecatedUrls
preferences.title: Hide Removed Commands
preferences.label: Hide commands removed from every browser
preferences.description: Hide commands that no longer exist in any supported browser. Turn this off to keep them searchable, with a note about when they were removed and what replaced them.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
